notes.title: Blood and Gore Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398310/2db9a9a901e4e800658c53b5884e2141e2958290.png"]


Hello everyone!
Today’s update brings some serious visual upgrades. I've added brand new random blood and gore effects that make every fight feel unique and intense. On top of that, bullets are now much easier to see in action, giving you better clarity during combat.


[previewyoutube="ZP_4dFEt8nw;full"][/previewyoutube]


Blood now sprays out in completely random patterns every time. No two gunfights or zombie killings will ever look the same. Depending on how you hit enemies, blood can splatter, soak the ground, or mist into the air. It’s chaotic, it’s gory, it feels right at home in the world of ApocaShift.


[previewyoutube="uwmEeakQIRc;full"][/previewyoutube]


I also gave some love to the bullets. They’ve been updated with a more noticeable design so you can clearly tell what you're shooting at in the middle of the action. Whether you're snapping off quick shots or unloading with a heavier weapon, you'll actually see the round flying toward your target.


[previewyoutube="90sMbfhO5RA;full"][/previewyoutube]
These changes are all about one thing, better feel during combat. You pull the trigger, you get the feedback. It’s visceral. It's clear. It's satisfying.

notes.title: ApocaShift - KickStarter Announcement and Summer Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398310/1a227d21730f3e2979534fdac5f49f604530693a.png"]
Summer ApocaShift UpdateSo much as been added and this might be the largest update yet as i push for a fun and playable build!
🔧 Major Features & Changes:
Storage Overhaul:
Items are now stored inside buildable storage containers instead of a centralized stash. You must walk up to these containers and use the new vicinity looting system to access their contents.

Zombie AI Rework:
Zombies now shamble and idle until they see or hear the player. Behavior is more natural and reactive.

Screamer Zombies Added:
These special infected will alert and aggro nearby zombies when disturbed—be careful!

More Special Zombies Coming Soon:

Chargers

Smoke Zombies

Acid Zombies
(Currently in development)

Train System Implemented:
A train is now used for deploying and extracting from raids. Eventually, it will become a late-game mobile base, which can be repaired, maintained, and driven around the map.

Ammo Management:
Ammo now takes up inventory space, adding another layer of realism and challenge.

Survival Status Indicators:
Indicators for Hunger, Thirst, and Bleeding have been added.

Medical System Rework:
The healing system has been redesigned to better reflect tactical and survival gameplay.

Hostile Bandit AI (WIP):
Bandits are being developed with hostile behaviors, expect gunfights and ambushes in future builds.

Custom Radio Stations:
You can now switch between several radio stations, including:

Ambient

Oldies

Rock

Punk Rock

Synth

Classical

Country

Weapon Carry Animations:
Added carrying animations for all two-handed guns, improving realism and immersion.

Fire & Burning Effects:
Fire effects have been added, enemies and objects can now burn under the right conditions.

Early Farming System:
Basic farming at your base is now possible, laying the groundwork for future survival mechanics.


[previewyoutube="vHyKVY4XwTA;full"][/previewyoutube]🛠️ Next Planned Features
Here’s a look at what’s coming next in ApocaShift:

Technology Tree
Unlock upgrades, structures, and survival advancements through a progression-based tech system.

Crafting System
Gather resources and materials to craft tools, weapons, gear, and survival essentials, as well as use buildable machines and workstations to create higher-tier items and advanced equipment.

Cooking Mechanics
Prepare food using raw ingredients and recipes, with hunger/thirst and potential buffs in mind.

Mining System
Extract raw resources like metal, stone, and fuel from the environment to support crafting, construction, and tech upgrades.

notes.title: ApocaShift Development Update - Base building and other additions
notes.notes:
I have some exciting news to announce! The new base building system is implemented and working! 

While there is only a few options here to choose from, I plan on having hundreds of different items / decorations / fauna / floors / buildings to choose from and cant wait to see some of the creations that are made.

[previewyoutube=y2igZXrREQw;full][/previewyoutube]

I still have to add the buildings actually using resources you collected when they are constructed, but I will show this off more when it is fully implemented.

Also i have finished all the backend code for the NPC menus. Many of these menus are Alpha stage and do not have any of the UI assets skinned onto them so don't be too appalled by them now! I promise they'll look better.

[previewyoutube=MfhmAsSQvIo;full][/previewyoutube]

5 new zombie variants added now having 6 total as well as over 30 different clothes for zombies.

[previewyoutube=cZ9LJdvrjKI;full][/previewyoutube]

and lastly different wild animals have been added!
